page.overview:
What is Leafeon?

Leafeon is a quadrupedal mammalian Pokémon whose most distinguishing features are its lithe felid body structure and the vegetation protruding from its body. Its long tail and long, rabbit-like ears resemble torn, tattered leaves. The ears themselves have brown insides. It has a distinctly cat-like morphology all around, with small features, a round head, short muzzle, brown eyes with white pupils, and a small triangular brown nose. There are a multitude of small leaves growing from its body, sprouting out from its knee joint areas, on the forelegs and hind legs, its chest, and its back. A larger, curled leaf grows from the middle of its forehead. Its body is tan-colored, while its feet end in caramel-brown points. Leafeon is the result of Eevee being exposed to a Moss Rock while leveling up, or in the case of Generation VIII onwards, absorbing the radiation of a Leaf Stone.

As a Shiny, Leafeon's fur is only slightly darker than its normal color, but its eyes have a lighter shade of brown.

Although they are willing to follow their Trainer's commands in battle or protect its friends, Leafeon's Pokémon Platinum Pokédex entry suggests that these Pokémon are mainly pacifists and do not like to fight. As shown in the anime, they are also quite gentle and kind. They spend the majority of their time bathing and basking under sunlight to perform photosynthesis (similar to Espeon), so they don't always need to eat.

As with other Eeveelutions, Leafeon are very rarely seen in the wild and commonly owned by Trainers in urban areas. They, however, inhabit quietly in forests that have clean flowing rivers.
